title: Gentle Shell · Your development, in good company
brief: GUI concepts for this repository, inspired by the supplied Slack interface and the personality and color codes of gentlemanprogramming.com. Preserve per-chat helpers and tasks. Standalone visual proposals only; no application implementation.

artboards.title: Workspace
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to Slack: familiar chat navigation with a fixed three-section panel (tasks, usage, agents) beside the conversation; uses more horizontal space.
